text: So what is it that I want to do? I think I realize that I need some kind of media strategy.
There's two things that I do, beyond being a project manager, which is the thing I do as a day
job. I write, I write, and I'm currently trying to write a book about project management and
game theory, and so I'm doing quite a lot of reading about game theory. So that's one thing
that I'm doing. And then the other thing that I do is I perform. So, and it feels weird saying
this because I don't think there are many other people who do this. So I did a fringe show last
year at the Edinburgh Festival called You Can Write a Book, and this year I'm thinking about
doing a show about game theory. I'm not sure what that's going to be called, but one of the things
I do is I use talking about these things as a way of understanding them. And so, and that's,
that's kind of why this is interesting. That kind of like my idea is that if I, if I can talk into
a video like this and then I can get the interesting bits of this video extracted relatively
automatically, then I can post to different social media channels and, and create some kind
of presence. So like I do have a sort of presence, but it's always been chaotic and how fast.
And there's definitely an aspect of the way I think about things that's chaotic and how fast.
I think like the way that's glossed is that I'm a generalist. So I don't think about things in a
linear fashion. I read all sorts of different things, read the wrong things, think about things.
I don't come up necessarily with overall structures. I can start at different levels. I was,
that's one of the points that I made actually in my show this year was like when you're reading,
you don't have to read from the beginning to the end. You don't have to read the structure that
is in there. You can read different bits. You can start in the middle. You can read detailed bits
and then read bits at not such a detailed level. And that's exactly what I do actually
when I'm thinking about things. And there is this idea that maybe if you're more organized that
that'd be better, but I'm not sure. So the main thing is that kind of something that I've learned
and something again I said in my show last year, this year is that talking about things is a way
of making things clear.
